spell.madoka_magic.witch_black_wings.des: Sweep a fan of dark wings forward. Enemies caught in the slash receive butterfly marks.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_cocoon_burst.de: Detonate your butterfly marks on nearby enemies. More stacks cause more damage.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_venom.desc: Strike the enemy in your sights with a venomous needle that inflicts poison.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_honey_tide.desc: Release a wave of sticky honey, damaging and slowing nearby enemies.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_tear_rain.desc: Summon several waves of rain at the casting point. Each wave damages enemies still in the area.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_thorn_echo.desc: Pierce the nearby enemy that owes you the most guilt, consuming its debt.

screen.madoka_magic.contract.hint_selfis: Reach out. The power you want is right here. Are you willing to pay its price yourself?

message.madoka_magic.witch_power_inherit: You inherited your witch's power. Use the transformation key to reveal your witch form.
spell.madoka_magic.butterfly_slash.desc: Sweep a cone in front of you. Hitting at least one target restores 1 health. A missed swing still spends mana.
spell.madoka_magic.tulip_burst.desc: Burst tulips around you, damaging nearby enemies and leaving butterfly marks.
spell.madoka_magic.bee_sting.desc: Sting the enemy you aim at and poison it for 5 seconds.
spell.madoka_magic.swarm_call.desc: Summon bees that follow you for a short time. They pursue nearby familiars and sting using your magic stats.
spell.madoka_magic.dandelion_drift.desc: Release seeds that seek honey-coated enemies first and spread honey on impact.
spell.madoka_magic.honey.desc: Coat the ground you aim at with honey, slowing familiars that enter. Level aim places it on the ground ahead.
spell.madoka_magic.injection.desc: Sting a familiar to restore health and mana. Honey-coated targets yield more health.
spell.madoka_magic.illusion.desc: Make nearby familiars temporarily attack allies they can see.
spell.madoka_magic.devotion_wing.desc: Each damaging attack or spell adds one butterfly mark. One golden butterfly orbits the target per mark, up to five.
spell.madoka_magic.selfish_eye.desc: Hits steal attack damage, health, and mana. Excess healing grants absorption. Keep a share of the stolen stats permanently when combat ends.
spell.madoka_magic.obsession.desc: Each kill adds a stack: +8% damage per stack, up to 5. Cleared after 20s without a kill.
spell.madoka_magic.ember.desc: Every 10 points of taint grants +2% damage. Burn yourself for power.
spell.madoka_magic.sin_mark.desc: Whenever an enemy damages you, it is branded and owes you guilt (capped at 50% of its max health). Guilt fuels Redemption Blade and the Unpayable Promise.
spell.madoka_magic.atonement_repay.desc: Dealing damage restores mana equal to 5% of the damage dealt. Works with both attacks and spells.
spell.madoka_magic.thorn_embrace.desc: Grow deep-blue thorns around you, binding up to 8 enemies for 6 seconds. This interrupts witch windups. Bound targets cannot start new Madoka skills, take damage each second, and accumulate guilt. Attacking them causes backlash.
spell.madoka_magic.redemption_blade.desc: Lock onto the enemy that owes you the most guilt, spend it for a burst of damage (execution: ignores same-faction reduction). You suffer 20% of the spent guilt as backlash.
spell.madoka_magic.unpayable_promise.des: Make a 10-second pact with a familiar that owes you guilt. Take 30% of its damage and return the stored remainder when the pact ends. The pool is lost if the target dies or leaves tether range.
spell.madoka_magic.pollen.desc: Damage over time to all enemies with butterfly marks; each stack grants +12% damage. Unmarked enemies are immune.
spell.madoka_magic.blossom.desc: Enter Bloom: costs 6 mana per second and your damage grows the longer the fight lasts. Running out of mana triggers the Fall.
spell.madoka_magic.wither.desc: Spend 15% of your health for a burst of damage. Hold Shift to pay with 10 taint instead. +50% damage while fallen.

lore.madoka_magic.contract.sacrifice.sec: the ashes of myself, for my first love.
lore.madoka_magic.contract.take.first: Fill these empty hands with honey,
lore.madoka_magic.contract.take.second: then borrow a heart for the next desire.
lore.madoka_magic.contract.atonement.fir: Let the apology I cannot speak
lore.madoka_magic.contract.atonement.sec: become a wish to bear your burdens.
lore.madoka_magic.contract.default.first: A wish waits upon this page
lore.madoka_magic.contract.default.secon: for someone to sign their name.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.sacrifice: Broken wings still seek the same person.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.sacrifice: The specimen is still; its ribbons remember the wind.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.take: An empty hive echoes with a hunger never satisfied.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.take: A borrowed smile is finally left outside the story.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.atonement: Within the broken frame, no one answers the apology.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.atonement: The rain has stopped; the missing page remains.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.kriemhild_g: Many wishes sleep within a single ray of light.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.kriemhild_g: May every sorrow find a tomorrow that does not repeat it.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.homulilly: The clock has passed its end; the march goes on.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.homulilly: A belated curtain call, gathered from an endless procession.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.candeloro: The tea is cold; a place is still set for the next guest.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.candeloro: One last sweet, left behind at an endless tea party.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.oktavia: A sunken melody still searches for an audience.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.oktavia: The final note falls, and the stage is quiet at last.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.ophelia: The candle burns brighter as the road home grows longer.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.ophelia: The hoofbeats fade; the embers keep an old vow.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.walpurgisna: On an inverted stage, the storm takes the final bow.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.walpurgisna: A fragment of dawn, brought back from the longest night.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.wither: Withered flowers remember the names of the silent.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.wither: An unfading ending to an unanswered elegy.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.gluttony: Its shape keeps changing; its hunger never does.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.gluttony: A swallowed shape has found its own boundaries at last.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.brunhilde: Even cooled lava bears the bite of a reckless charge.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.brunhilde: Beyond the ash lies a courage that no longer burns.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.sieglinde: Words that cannot be taken back echo inside the cracks.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.sieglinde: Hold gently the yesterday that cannot return.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.annegret: Frosting seals away the bitterness, and the way out.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.annegret: This final sweetness asks for no bitterness in return.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.netherite_m: The anvil is silent; unfinished wishes still burn.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.netherite_m: A cooled spark remembers the final hammer blow.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.ignis: The altar is consumed, but the fire will not die.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.ignis: Save the last warmth for a tomorrow that need not burn.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.ender_guard: Nothing remains beyond the door, yet the chains tighten.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.ender_guard: The sealed door has finally ended its vigil.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.the_harbing: Broken orbits keep pointing toward the same end.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.the_harbing: Leave the disaster that never came beyond this eclipse.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.the_leviath: A wish sinks slowly through violet-black tides.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.the_leviath: A thread of light, recovered from an echo-less depth.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.amethyst_cr: Between the crystal layers lie cracks that never healed.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.amethyst_cr: The light in these shards no longer wounds the hand.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.ancient_rem: The throne is dust; broken columns still stand for the past.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.ancient_rem: A grain of sand keeps a place for a fallen story.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.maledictus: A broken balance cannot weigh a word of forgiveness.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.maledictus: The black feather falls, and the judgment ceases to echo.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.scylla: The tide takes the song, but not its calling.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.scylla: The deep-sea echo no longer leads anyone astray.
lore.madoka_magic.grief_seed.default: A wish wrapped in darkness still holds a little warmth.
lore.madoka_magic.witch_kiss.default: A mark of the despair you once faced.

tooltip.madoka_magic.shimmer.contract: Before a name is written, a wish has no weight.
tooltip.madoka_magic.shimmer.butterfly_b: Turn the page; the wings will finish the rest.
tooltip.madoka_magic.shimmer.queen_sting: The honey is sweet, the sting is cold, and both obey only you.
tooltip.madoka_magic.shimmer.thorn_great: Wrapped around the blade are debts not yet repaid.
tooltip.madoka_magic.cluster_hint: Combine with a weapon in an anvil to engrave it.
advancements.madoka_magic.desk.title: A desk
advancements.madoka_magic.desk.descripti: Wood, flowers, honey, set out as a table you can write on.
advancements.madoka_magic.first_contract: Three contracts on the desk. You have wanted to ask this for a long time.
The door opened where you fell, shaped like a torn flower.
advancements.madoka_magic.grief_seed_use: Her remains washed the dirt off you. Each wash leaves less of her.
advancements.madoka_magic.first_curse.de: In Kazumi Magica the Pleiades Saints forged witches' curses into weapons. So did you.
advancements.madoka_magic.half_witch.des: Half-witch is this pack's own invention. The human half bought the strength.
advancements.madoka_magic.despair.title: Despair
advancements.madoka_magic.despair.descri: You died full of taint. What grew out of it became a witch, and you cut it down yourself.
advancements.madoka_magic.full_purity.de: The gem is too bright to look at. There is no road past this.
advancements.madoka_magic.star_map.title: The whole star map
advancements.madoka_magic.star_map.descr: Every star on the talent map is lit.
advancements.madoka_magic.walpurgis.desc: The stage came down and the thunder withdrew.
advancements.madoka_magic.witch_hunter.d: You have met every kind of witch there is.
